questions.question: If p(x) = x⁴ - 2x³ + 5x - 6 and (x - 1) is a factor, find p(1).
questions.explanation: By the Factor Theorem, if (x - a) is a factor of p(x), then p(a) = 0. Since (x - 1) is a factor, p(1) = 0.
steps: 1. Recall Factor Theorem: (x - a) is factor ⇔ p(a) = 0.
questions.fastStrategy: Factor Theorem: (x - a) is factor iff p(a) = 0.
